name: A hunting team in the forest
win: take their scroll, or drive them off (two of three downed)
lose: your scroll is taken or the squad is downed

phases.name: Ambush
phases.behaviour: traps and a genjutsu opener from the trees; one fighter stays hidden
phases.openings: sensing and Byakugan find the hidden one

phases.name: Hunt
phases.behaviour: they split your squad: one each
phases.openings: regroup command and a squad combo
